headline: Everything you own and owe, in one view
lede: Assets and liabilities side by side, with net worth worked out for you.
caption: Know your worth. Track your wealth.

pin.title: Net Worth Tracker Spreadsheet for Google Sheets and Excel
pin.description: List your accounts, investments, property and loans once, then update the values each month. The tracker groups assets and liabilities, calculates your net worth and logs the month-over-month change, so you can see where you stand going into the new year.
pin.alt: Dark net worth tracker spreadsheet on a laptop with total assets, liabilities and net worth, under the headline Everything you own and owe, in one view.
